path_cases.name: 2017-08-21 total eclipse — NASA central line
path_cases.source_notes: Seven sparse check points sampled from the NASA GSFC WGS 84 central-line table, whose published rows are spaced at 120-second intervals. The table clock is Universal Time and is preserved as time_ut1. The 5 km screening tolerance includes the difference between the reference prediction realization and this project's ephemeris/time-scale configuration; it is not an accuracy claim.

path_cases.name: 2026-08-12 total eclipse — NASA central line
path_cases.source_notes: Seven sparse check points sampled from the NASA GSFC WGS 84 central-line table. NASA states this prediction uses VSOP87/ELP2000-85 and Delta-T=71.4 seconds. The default operational EOP run uses the configured Skyfield time-scale source rather than forcing that historical Delta-T; previous comparisons show several-kilometre realization differences. The 15 km limit is a broad regression screen, not a precision claim. A separate fixed-Delta-T run can reproduce the published realization more closely.
